description.value: The Art of Slow Food is an exclusively gluten-free artisan bakery and café located in downtown Victoria, just behind the Victoria Public Market on Fisgard Street. Built around old-world food traditions, it produces sourdough bread, wild-fermented vegetables, cultured dairy, and bone broth using local organic ingredients in small batches. For touring cyclists with gluten intolerance or dietary restrictions, it is a notably rare dedicated GF option in the city core.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: bollard (4 spaces, covered) at 65m. Total: 4 spaces.
